directive_basis: R404 directive item 7: determine exactly what the P25 failure means relative to P13. Create predecessor / failure / causal implication / new architecture / remaining uncertainty. Do not let a predecessor failure either disappear or incorrectly kill its descendant.

predecessor.identity: P-25 — Self-Referencing Piezoresistive Pressure Sensor (born R336 as autonomous-discovery candidate CAND-002, machine-generated, survived 6 hostile admission attacks, promoted to P-25)
predecessor.design: Dual-element differential measurement: an exposed active piezoresistive element + a reference element sharing the thermal environment; the bridge output cancels common-mode drift
predecessor.death: R337 computational falsification FAIL -> R347 CEO-ordered move to the Internal Knowledge Cemetery -> R370J reconciliation CF-004 re-confirms the state ('P-25 was killed/cemeteried before R370B; not in current canonical 15')

what_failed: Falsification threshold 2.0 mmHg NOT met: dual-element residual error 3.45 mmHg over 30 days (single-element reference: 10.73 mmHg)
Common-mode drift cancellation measured in-model at 67.8 % — the cancellation itself WORKS
Root cause: biofouling (3 µV/day, affecting ONLY the exposed element) and asymmetric creep (0.5 µV/day) are NON-COMMON-MODE — the differential bridge does not cancel them
failure.classification_at_failure: T1-FAIL — mechanism limitation, NOT implementation failure (R337 audit, Constitution Art. XXIX: the model ran, the physics is real, the mechanism is insufficient for the clinical threshold)
cemetery_records: R347/cemetery/CEMETERY_ENTRIES.json — P-25 entry: KA-P-25-CEMETERY-001 + discovery constraint DC-P-25-001 ('future candidates with similar mechanism must address the identified failure before admission')
premium_package_factory/gates/r370j_audit_reconciliation.py CF-004 (P-25 confirmed dead, not in current canonical 15)
failure.cemetery_rule: 'A candidate in the cemetery cannot be revived without a constitutional waiver' (R347 cemetery_entries.json closing rule)
failure.boundary_condition_left_open: The R347 cemetery entry itself names the open question: 'Whether anti-fouling coating or periodic recalibration can bring error below 2.0 mmHg. If not, mechanism is falsified for absolute measurement (may survive for trending only).'

causal_implication.what_the_failure_establishes: Self-referencing ALONE is insufficient for absolute pressure accuracy in a fouling environment: the bridge cancels common-mode (thermal) drift — measured 67.8 % effective in the model — but non-common-mode drift (asymmetric biofouling on the exposed element, asymmetric creep) passes straight through the differential output.
causal_implication.what_it_does_not_establish: It does not falsify the common-mode cancellation itself; it does not falsify the architecture for trending-class use; and per Art. XXIX it does not kill the mechanism family — it CONDITIONS re-admission on addressing the non-common-mode channel (DC-P-25-001).
causal_implication.implication_for_P13: P13 inherits exactly this conditional: its single claim (drift advantage vs a single-ended baseline) survives ONLY IF the non-common-mode channel (biofouling, reference drift) does not erase the common-mode gain. The BENCHMARK_SPECIFICATION's biofouling_channel field and the DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT's fouling-exposure arm measure precisely this channel first.

new_architecture.identity: P-27-R1 (current P13) — the same self-referencing dual-element family: active sensor die (0.07 mm diaphragm after the R381 KEEP mutation) + shielded reference die on a carrier platform; shipped CAD VALID through all geometry gates, independently re-verified at R404 (GEOMETRY_REVERIFICATION_EVIDENCE.json)
design_deltas_vs_P25: diaphragm thickness 0.12 -> 0.07 mm (R381 KEEP mutation; sensitivity ~1/t^2 MODELLED, ×2.939)
recorded mitigations in the current dossier's failure-mode table: 'Periodic recalibration protocol + spare capacity'
hermeticity spec MIL-STD-883 leak < 1e-8 atm·cc/s (planned, not tested)
new_architecture.what_did_NOT_change: The non-common-mode drift channel is NOT recorded as repaired: no anti-fouling mechanism, no non-common-mode compensation element, and no recalibration-interval demonstration exists in the package. 'Periodic recalibration' is the P-25 cemetery entry's own OPEN boundary question carried forward as a mitigation LABEL — not a demonstrated repair.
new_architecture.re_admission_path: The technology re-entered the buyer corpus at the R370 build (premium_package_factory/templates/build_portfolio.py PACKAGE_MAP row 13: 'P-27-R1' / 'pressure_sensor') when the P-27-R1 label — previously the OLD P-27 (shape-memory-polymer catheter)'s metallic-tubing repair candidate — was reassigned to this sensor technology. The R403 NOVELTY_ASSESSMENT documents the same collision as audit conflict C3 (the lineage mis-attribution in R370/claim_level/ALL_CLAIMS.json row P-27-R1-C002).

lineage_narrative_mis_attribution.why_it_is_wrong: The 'original P-27' was the Shape-Memory Polymer kink-resistant catheter (born R347 as a P-25/P-10 replacement) — a DIFFERENT technology with no self-referencing bridge and no chronic-drift record. lineage_narrative_mis_attribution.biofouling_erasure: The frozen dossier contains ZERO mentions of biofouling or non-common-mode drift — the predecessor's exact measured kill channel is absent from the buyer-facing failure-mode table (its 'chronic drift' failure modes carry 'UNKNOWN — no sourced evidence' labels instead of the P-25 measured 3.45 mmHg record). lineage_narrative_mis_attribution.disposition: DISCLOSED, not rewritten: the frozen corpus and the buyer-distribution repository are release-chain territory (Art. XXXIX) — zero buyer-surface bytes are modified this round. directive_answer.does_the_predecessor_failure_kill_P13: NO — per Art. XXIX the T1-FAIL was a mechanism-insufficiency finding (not an invariant impossibility proof, and the design space of non-common-mode countermeasures is not exhausted), and the cemetery rule itself conditions re-admission rather than eternal prohibition. The failure does not disappear either: it defines P13's largest scientific risk (the non-common-mode channel), which the paired-die benchmark and its fouling arm measure FIRST.
directive_answer.has_it_disappeared: It had PARTIALLY disappeared in the frozen buyer dossier (biofouling 0 mentions; wrong predecessor narrative; failure modes relabeled 'UNKNOWN — no sourced evidence' where a measured predecessor record exists). The R403 benchmark specification and this lineage audit restore it to the engine-side canonical record; the buyer-surface correction is a release operation.
